description: This file defines various UI components for a React-based project, including modal dialogs, toast notifications, input controls, and UI elements with associated behavior and styling.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: A React component that creates a popover element, displaying children and content with overlay mask.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled card container for child elements.

methods.name: ListItem
methods.description: A React component representing an item in a list with optional icon, subtitle, and click handler.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A React component rendering a list container for child elements.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A React component displaying a centered loading indicator.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: A React component for displaying modal dialogs with header, content, and footer with actions.

methods.name: showModal
methods.description: Function to dynamically create and display a modal overlay.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: A React component for displaying transient toast messages with optional action buttons.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Function to display a toast message for a specified duration.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A React component that renders a textarea input with optional auto-height.

methods.name: PasswordInput
methods.description: A React component with a toggle to show/hide password text.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: A React component for a styled dropdown select with custom icon.

methods.name: showConfirm
methods.description: Function to display a confirmation modal dialog with Cancel and Confirm actions.

methods.name: PromptInput
methods.description: Internal component for input in prompt modal dialogs.

methods.name: showPrompt
methods.description: Function to display a prompt modal for user input with customizable default value.

methods.name: showImageModal
methods.description: Function to display an image in a modal preview.

methods.name: Selector
methods.description: A component for selecting an item from a list, supporting single selection.
